Alina (People Ops): Heads-up: review window closing next Fri. We're getting last-minute reviewer swaps and a couple of timezone conflicts. Please confirm backups and populate the backup template by EOD Wednesday.
Ben (ENG Manager): Will do. Question can backups be senior ICs who haven't done calibration training?
Alina (People Ops): Prefer managers or trained senior ICs. If it's an untrained IC, note it in the review comment and we'll add them to a rapid calibration mini-session.
Diego (SRE): One of our reviewers is on-call the week of the deadline. Can on-call coverage be treated as a valid reason to auto-assign a backup?
Alina (People Ops): Yes. Use the comment format: `Backup assigned due to on-call: Name (reason)`. That preserves the audit trail.
Harper (Recruiting): FYI I can float candidate interviews around 2-hour windows if that helps reviewers who are candidates clashes. Send me names + ranges.
Ben (ENG Manager): If a reviewer already submitted a draft and we swap them, does the backup need to re-run the form or can they annotate?
Alina (People Ops): Annotate is fine. Backup should open the draft, add a `Re-reviewed by <name> on <date>` line and a short rationale. Only reopen the form if the rating changes materially.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Populate reviewer backup template" in 36 hours. :bell:
Diego (SRE): Can you drop a one-paragraph guidance for reviewers so everyone's language is consistent in calibration? Last cycle wording varied a lot.
Alina (People Ops): Pasted snippet for reviewers (use verbatim in notes):
"Read self-assessment; evaluate against rubric (impact, autonomy, craft); cite one clear example for strength and one for growth; flag if borderline/underscored/overstated; conclude with 1-2 sentence rationale for rating."
Harper (Recruiting): Added two 30-min slots to the calendar for quick reviewer handoffs: Thu 15:00 GMT and Fri 08:00 PT. I'll accept invites if you drop names.
Ben (ENG Manager): Added backups for my team: Mira (backup, CET) and Omar (backup, PST). Mira is on PTO Thu am so Omar will cover then.
Alina (People Ops): Thanks. If anyone substitutes after submission, DM me and cc people-ops@redwood.com so we can update the calibration packet. If you need the template link again ping me.
Ben (ENG Manager): Template link please?
Alina (People Ops): https://drive.google.com/fake/redwood-review-backup-template (file: reviewer_backups.csv + reviewer_quick_guide.md). Fill name, role, Lattice handle, timezone.
Diego (SRE): I'll try to join the Fri 08:00 PT handoff for SRE borderline cases.
Alina (People Ops): Great. If anything else comes up after EOD Wednesday, DM and we'll triage. Thanks all!
